Henri B. Kagan · Kenso Soai

For the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

WHY IT MATTERS

Small imbalance, amplified

Mirror-image molecules can behave differently in living systems. Their work showed how asymmetric reactions and autocatalysis can strongly amplify a tiny initial preference for one molecular handedness.

Verified source ↗
INPUTA minute chiral imbalance
PROCESSAsymmetric catalysis + self-amplification
OUTPUTPredominantly one molecular handedness
